reference.title: Legacy lexicon cannot be installed to
reference.shortdesc: In Niagara 4.14, when you connect to , the Lexicon Installer option is not available from the Platform Nav tree and there is also no installer option in the commissioning wizard.

section.note:
In Niagara 4.14, the Lexicon Installer platform view does not permit the installation of legacy lexicon files. When connected to a platform, or any read-only Home environment, the Lexicon Installer view is not present under the Platform Nav Tree and while commissioning the the Install lexicons to support additional languages step does not exist in the Commissioning Wizard.
The Lexicon Installer does not exist in the Platform Nav Tree and Commissioning Wizard.
